purpose: The enumerated set of cases that are allowed to be non-passing in CI, with a reason and the blocker that owns each one. This exists so that an HONEST unknown does not make CI permanently red, without ever converting an unknown into a pass.
rules: An entry here does NOT make its test pass. The test still reports UNRESOLVED in every report.
The CI gate passes only if every non-passing case is listed here. Any NEW unresolved or withdrawn case fails the build.
Any FAIL anywhere always fails the build, listed here or not: a contradiction is never acceptable.
Adding an entry requires a blocker id in reports/PHASE_01C_OPEN_BLOCKERS.json. An entry whose blocker is closed must be removed, and the gate fails if it is not.
This file is the only place an unknown may be tolerated. It is not a suppression list and it prints every entry in the job summary.

entries.reason: No coupled piezothermoelastic scattering solver exists, so R/T/A cannot be evaluated. The case exists to say so explicitly rather than to be omitted.
entries.closes_when: a coupled solver reproduces the elastic reference (test SCT01) and a numerical energy balance closes

entries.reason: The production k=0 reduction returns a transmitted potential that misses the k->0 limit for every metal|piezo pair: 6.3e-4 relative for Al6061|PZT-5H P, and |phi|/FS = 0 against limits of 1.5e-5 to 2.3e-5 for the other three. Cause identified: assembly.py removes the phi row when the INCIDENT wave carries no potential, and Al6061 has e=0 so an incident wave in it has phi=0 exactly. No claim about normal-incidence amplitudes across a metal|piezo interface is asserted while this is open.
entries.closes_when: the k=0 mode count for a metal|piezo contact is re-derived (BLK-02A-27), [[phi]]=0 is imposed by a route that does not depend on the incident amplitude, and this test's measured disagreement falls below 1e-6 of the field scale
